name: Iron Dome battery
protection: Unarmoured launcher trailer and radar. Unarmoured. Game rule still treats the vehicle body as immune to small-calibre, but 7.62x54R and up penetrate; occupants, glass and tyres are exposed to all fire. Game: background map set piece and sky effects (interceptions), not a combat vehicle.
visual_notes: Box launcher holding 20 vertical-angled tubes on a tracked trailer or truck
Separate EL/M-2084 flat-panel radar on a trailer
Dirt revetments and camouflage nets around sites
